remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Knight Pub. O'Keeffe 1937. Color Plate. No. 12 'Cross by the Sea, Gaspé.'" Abiquiú Notebooks notes star from backing inscription 1. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert." Reproduced and titled *Cross by the Sea – Canada* in *America & Alfred Stieglitz* (1934); *Cross by the Sea* in *Life* (February 1938); *Cross by the Sea* in *Bulletin of the Art Institute of Chicago* (February 1943); reproduced *Art Digest* (February 1943). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: The Currier Gallery of Art, Manchester, New Hampshire, Currier Funds (1960.1)
description: A large wooden cross dominates the canvas. The cross bears a sign with text in French that commemorates a man's death. A white picket fence surrounds the cross. The structure stands over a rippling ocean with a blue sky overhead.
title: Cross by the Sea, Canada
